meta.notes: Phase 2 classification is based on live verification, not the source spec's assumptions — the spec's Workday/Oracle/Taleo guesses were wrong often enough (Franklin Templeton, PwC AC, EY GDS, Standard Chartered's URL, KPMG's bucket, and Bank of America/Barclays/Visa/AIG/CME Group being misfiled as custom when they're actually Workday) that every employer here was checked against its real, live site on 2026-09-13 rather than trusted. 'oracle' now means Oracle Fusion Recruiting Cloud (oraclecloud.com HCM Candidate Experience) specifically — no employer was found running genuine legacy Taleo, so that ats_type/scraper doesn't exist in this codebase. 'custom' covers Phenom People, SAP SuccessFactors, and not-yet-identified platforms alike, served by one CustomScraper via sitemap.xml + schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD rather than per-vendor code. Deloitte USI is confirmed Avature but its sitemap is a dead stub, so it stays inactive pending a direct-HTML-listing scraper. 15 employers remain active:false pending further verification (bot-protected, JS-SPA-only, or stale URLs) — see each entry's 'note' for why and what's needed.
